title: Introduction
description: What Stance is: the open-source Binds design system with design tokens, light, dark and high-contrast themes, and accessible React components.

title: Platform strategy
description: How Stance works across web, iOS and Android: one token source and shared meaning, with native controls, navigation and accessibility on each platform.

title: Installation
description: Install @bindshq/stance-tokens and @bindshq/stance-react, import the styles once, load DM Sans, and use the Tailwind v3 or v4 presets.

title: Quick start
description: Set up ThemeProvider and ThemeScript, build a form with FormField and Dialog, add a theme switcher and use Stance tokens in your own CSS.

title: Architecture
description: How Stance is built: two packages, layered design tokens, a plain-CSS styling model and dependency-free accessibility primitives.

title: Theming
description: Configure light, dark and high-contrast themes in Stance: system detection, persistence, no-flash script, scoped themes and keeping saved preferences.

title: Accessibility
description: How Stance meets WCAG 2.2 AA: verified contrast in every theme, axe tests in three modes, WAI-ARIA keyboard patterns and focus management.

title: Colour
description: The two Binds brand colours, the 15-step ink scale interpolated between them, and every semantic colour role for light, dark and high contrast.

title: Typography
description: The Stance type system: DM Sans on a 1.2 scale, font sizes, weights, line heights and letter spacing, with guidance for UI and long-form text.

title: Spacing
description: The Stance spacing scale on a 4px grid, shared control heights for buttons and inputs, and rhythm guidance for related elements and sections.

title: Layout
description: Stance breakpoints, container widths and layout principles for mobile-first, intrinsic layouts that reflow cleanly from 320px to wide desktops.

title: Radius
description: Stance corner radius tokens from 4px to fully rounded, when to use each one for controls, surfaces and pills, and how to nest rounded corners.

title: Elevation
description: Stance shadow tokens for light and dark themes, solid outlines in high contrast, and the fixed z-index scale for overlays, menus and toasts.

title: Motion
description: Stance motion tokens: durations and easing curves for hover, overlays and dialogs, with reduced-motion support and rules for purposeful animation.

title: Icons
description: The original Stance icon set: a 24px grid with 1.75 stroke that inherits text colour, plus a searchable gallery and accessible usage guidance.

title: Design tokens
description: The Stance token pipeline: one W3C-format source that generates CSS, TypeScript, Swift and Kotlin, with validation, parity and contrast checks.

title: iOS installation
description: Install StanceUI for iOS and iPadOS with Swift Package Manager, wrap your app in StanceThemeProvider and build a first SwiftUI screen.

title: iOS theming
description: Light, dark and high-contrast themes in StanceUI: system detection, Increase Contrast, persistence, scoped themes and Dynamic Type.

title: UIKit interoperability
description: Use Stance colours and fonts in UIKit, host StanceUI views in view controllers, and wrap UIKit views inside StanceUI screens.

title: Android installation
description: Add Stance for Android with Gradle, apply Theme.Stance, wrap your content in StanceTheme and use Material 3 components on brand.

title: Android theming
description: Light, dark and high-contrast themes in Jetpack Compose with StanceTheme: system contrast detection, persistence, type scale and motion.

title: Adaptive layouts and Views
description: Edge-to-edge scaffolds, adaptive navigation for phones, tablets and foldables, and adopting Stance step by step in View-based apps.

title: Forms
description: Form patterns for Stance: structure, labels, validation timing, error messages and the right controls on web, iOS and Android.

title: Authentication
description: Sign-in and sign-up patterns: layout, autofill-friendly fields, password visibility, secure error messages and platform sign-in.

title: Dashboards
description: Dashboard patterns: hierarchy of figures and work lists, loading, empty and error states, and adaptive layouts across platforms.

title: Data tables
description: Choosing between Table, DataTable and DataGrid, table design rules, bulk and row actions, and how tables become lists on phones.

title: Navigation
description: Navigation patterns for product areas, sections and depth, and how navigation adapts from phones to desktops on each platform.

title: Search and filtering
description: Search and filter patterns: placement, live results, announcing counts, filter chips, sheets on phones and shareable filter state.

title: Notifications and feedback
description: When to use a toast, snackbar, inline alert, banner, dialog or notification list, and the rules that keep feedback accessible.

title: Documents and signatures
description: Patterns for previewing documents, uploading files and capturing signatures accessibly on web, iOS and Android.

title: AI assistants and agents
description: Patterns for assistants and agents: show the work, ask before acting, review changes before they land, and render answers safely on every platform.

title: Design principles
description: The six principles behind Stance: brand-true colour, accessibility by default, precision, editorial restraint, owning the stack and shared foundations.

title: Composition
description: How to compose Stance components: compound parts, the asChild prop for router links, controlled and uncontrolled state, and extending styles safely.

title: Responsive design
description: Responsive guidance for Stance: mobile-first layouts, how components adapt on small screens, touch target sizes, and reflow at 400% zoom.

title: Interaction patterns
description: Interaction patterns in Stance: interactive states, choosing between dialogs, popovers, menus and drawers, feedback timing and destructive actions.

title: Content guidelines
description: Writing for Binds products with Stance: voice and tone, sentence case, verb-first buttons, helpful errors, empty states, numbers and dates.

title: Accessibility standards
description: A practical WCAG 2.2 AA checklist for product screens built with Stance, organised as perceivable, operable, understandable and robust.

title: Releases
description: Stance release history and package versions, how @bindshq/stance-tokens and @bindshq/stance-react are versioned, and the product adoption policy.

title: Changelog
description: Every notable change to Stance by release, starting with 0.1.1: tokens, themes, components, accessibility primitives and the documentation site.

title: Contributing
description: How to contribute to Stance: development setup, adding a component with tests and docs, the checks every pull request passes, and changesets.

title: Brand
description: The official Stance logo, mark and app icons in SVG and PNG, with colour rules, clear space, minimum sizes and downloads for every variant.

title: License
description: Stance is open source under the MIT License. Read the full licence text and the note on Binds and Stance trademarks and logos.
